# Witchcraft AI (witchcraft.business)

> The house index of Witchcraft AI, an AI studio based in Sydney, Australia. It lists the live Witchcraft AI surfaces and hosts Witchcraft Setter, an AI appointment setter for high-ticket sales teams.

## Witchcraft Setter

- [Witchcraft Setter](https://witchcraft.business/setter/): AI appointment setter for high-ticket inbound sales teams (coaches, consultants, agencies, clinics, real estate, premium home services). Replies to every opted-in inbound lead on the channel they used (voice, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram DM, Messenger, email) within about 10 seconds, qualifies them against the closers' criteria, warm-transfers hot leads to a live closer mid-call, books the rest, and runs show-rate reminders and no-show rebooking. Priced per showed call (pilot: 50 USD per showed call, no setup fee, 30-day split-flow pilot). Pre-launch: performance figures are pilot targets, not published results. Inbound and opted-in only; discloses that it is an AI; honours opt-outs on every channel; official APIs only.
